verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show LangChain's docs site serves an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) that covers the LangGraph docs. Individual LangGraph pages are served as Markdown (.md) and each carries a 'Documentation Index' header pointing agents back to llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent community confirmation of agents using these docs in practice, and first-party guidance on llms.txt usage (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.langchain.com/llms.txt
